nodes.label: Server-Only CCXT
nodes.rationale: CCXT calls run only on the server—keys never reach the client; all /api/exchange/* routes require authentication.

nodes.label: Path alias convention (@/ -> src/)
nodes.rationale: Provides a stable, refactor-safe import root so files can be moved without breaking relative imports.

nodes.label: Server secrets via getEnv() convention
nodes.rationale: Centralizing env access through the Zod-validated getEnv() prevents ad hoc process.env reads in feature code that skip validation/typing and risk missing or malformed secrets.

nodes.label: Thin API route handlers convention
nodes.rationale: Keeping route handlers thin (Zod validation + requireSession auth, real logic in src/lib/**) separates HTTP concerns from business logic, making handlers easier to test and logic reusable across routes.

nodes.label: Private exchange routes require session convention
nodes.rationale: Starting private exchange routes with requireSession() and returning its response on failure centralizes auth-failure handling and prevents inconsistent unauthorized responses across endpoints.
nodes.norm_label: private exchange routes require session convention

nodes.label: DB schema/migration convention
nodes.rationale: A single schema module with a Neon HTTP client, preference for text PKs, and Better Auth-compatible naming keeps the schema coherent and adapter-compatible; running db:generate and committing SQL under drizzle/ keeps migrations reviewable and reproducible.

nodes.label: Prefer existing UI primitives convention
nodes.rationale: Reusing src/components/ui primitives instead of new one-offs keeps the UI visually and behaviorally consistent across the app.

nodes.label: Client feedback via notify() convention
nodes.rationale: Using the shared notify() helper instead of ad-hoc toasts ensures consistent user feedback styling and sound behavior across the app.

nodes.label: Exchange API keys only via ENCRYPTION_KEY storage convention
nodes.rationale: Restricting live exchange API keys/secrets to ENCRYPTION_KEY-protected storage via encryption.ts prevents secrets from leaking into plaintext DB columns, logs, or config files.
nodes.norm_label: exchange api keys only via encryption_key storage convention
